title: Annotatio IV §.II close: Mode merely Spiritual / Supernatural / Celestial — stop before §.III
pass_a_gloss: But this Mode both of presence and of participation of Christ’s flesh and blood is merely Spiritual, Supernatural, Celestial, opposed to the corporal, natural, carnal and local — whether more or less Capernaite.
pass_b_english: That Mode of presence and participation is merely Spiritual, Supernatural, Celestial.
It stands against corporal, natural, carnal, local presence — Capernaite in greater or lesser degree.
Stop before §.III (four proofs that John 6 inculcates the spiritual mode).
source_text: Est verò hic Modus tàm præsentiæ, quàm participationis carnis & sanguinis Christi, mere Spiritualis, Supernaturalis, Cælestis, corporali, naturali, carnali localique, ceu vel magis, vel minus Capernaitico, oppositus.
